join: one-to-one on 11-digit GEOID; every boundary feature matched; ACS-only areas verified to contain zero renter households
precision_note: Cutoff is an author stability rule on estimated households, not an unweighted survey sample-size test.
moe_note: 90% MOEs; sums/differences use root-sum-of-squares approximation; subset share formula uses ratio fallback for negative radicand. Grouped approximations ignore unavailable covariances and rent-band assignment uncertainty.
censoring_note: B25064_001E=3501 or + annotation is treated as $3,500 or more; no exact upper rent is inferred.
geographic_note: Main map zoom is -118.78,33.68,-117.66,34.40 in WGS84. Full-county inset includes all source boundary features. Place points are orientation labels, not neighborhood boundaries.
